item.title: [AI & I by Every] A New Vision for Human Work After Automation
item.description:
Hey, welcome back to the Every Podcast, where we talk about the future of work.
I'm Natalia Quintero, and at Every, our team of writers and builders use AI every day, so we can tell you how the frontier is shifting, what actually works, and what you need to know.
So last week at Every, we hosted our first ever conference, V.C.S.S.,
It was a full day of talks in Brooklyn featuring speakers from Anthropic, OpenAI, Notion, Lovable, Ode, and many more.
